title: Fase 7: preparación y readiness de Docker/despliegue privado
implemented: Versioned image tag parameter UEH_IMAGE_TAG with rollback procedure.
Deployment runbook for private Linux host, health checks, authenticated TLS proxy, smoke test and rollback.

Compose mounts the approved F3 calibration cache and adult-only 2025 service samples as read-only secrets.
Compose services remain bound to loopback; containers run read-only, non-root, with capabilities dropped and no-new-privileges.
remaining: Place the approved adult_service_samples.json outside the repository and restrict its host permissions.
Restrict the approved host cache so container UID/GID 10001 can read it without granting access to other host users.
Run preflight, build and start both services on a host with Docker Engine and Compose v2.
Verify both secrets are readable from the running container; test both health endpoints and a UI-to-API-to-Mesa simulation.
Review resource use and logs on the target host.
Configure the real TLS/authenticated reverse proxy, firewall and rollback target.
Complete phase 6 validation before opening deployment to pilot users.
